verses.literal: Then the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: DEPOIS falou o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: רְאֵ֖ה קָרָ֣אתִֽי בְשֵׁ֑ם בְּצַלְאֵ֛ל בֶּן־ אוּרִ֥י בֶן־ ח֖וּר לְמַטֵּ֥ה יְהוּדָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: rə·’êh qā·rā·ṯî ḇə·šêm bə·ṣal·’êl ben- ’ū·rî ḇen- ḥūr lə·maṭ·ṭêh yə·hū·ḏāh
verses.literal: See I have called by name Bezalel son of Uri the son of Hur of the tribe of Judah
verses.literalPt: Eis que eu tenho chamado por nome a Bezalel, o filho de Uri, filho de Hur, da tribo de Judá,

verses.original: וָאֲמַלֵּ֥א אֹת֖וֹ ר֣וּחַ אֱלֹהִ֑ים בְּחָכְמָ֛ה וּבִתְבוּנָ֥ה וּבְדַ֖עַת וּבְכָל־ מְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ă·mal·lê ’ō·ṯōw rū·aḥ ’ĕ·lō·hîm bə·ḥā·ḵə·māh ū·ḇiṯ·ḇū·nāh ū·ḇə·ḏa·‘aṯ ū·ḇə·ḵāl mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: And I have filled him with the Spirit of God with skill ability and knowledge in all kinds of craftsmanship
verses.literalPt: E o enchi do Espírito de Deus, de sabedoria, e de entendimento, e de ciência, em todo o lavor,

verses.original: לַחְשֹׁ֖ב מַחֲשָׁבֹ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֛וֹת בַּזָּהָ֥ב וּבַכֶּ֖סֶף וּבַנְּחֹֽשֶׁת׃
verses.transliteration: laḥ·šōḇ ma·ḥă·šā·ḇōṯ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ baz·zā·hāḇ ū·ḇak·ke·sep̄ ū·ḇan·nə·ḥō·šeṯ
verses.literal: to design artistic works in gold silver and bronze
verses.literalPt: Para elaborar projetos, e trabalhar em ouro, em prata, e em cobre,

verses.original: וּבַחֲרֹ֥שֶׁת אֶ֛בֶן לְמַלֹּ֖את וּבַחֲרֹ֣שֶׁת עֵ֑ץ לַעֲשׂ֖וֹת בְּכָל־ מְלָאכָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇa·ḥă·rō·šeṯ ’e·ḇen lə·mal·lōṯ ū·ḇa·ḥă·rō·šeṯ ‘êṣ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ bə·ḵāl mə·lā·ḵāh
verses.literal: to cut gemstones for settings and to carve wood so that he may be a master of every craft
verses.literalPt: E em lapidar pedras para engastar, e em entalhes de madeira, para trabalhar em todo o lavor.

verses.original: וַאֲנִ֞י הִנֵּ֧ה נָתַ֣תִּי אִתּ֗וֹ אֵ֣ת אָהֳלִיאָ֞ב בֶּן־ אֲחִֽיסָמָךְ֙ לְמַטֵּה־ דָ֔ן וּבְלֵ֥ב כָּל־ חֲכַם־ לֵ֖ב נָתַ֣תִּי חָכְמָ֑ה וְעָשׂ֕וּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־ אֲשֶׁ֥ר צִוִּיתִֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wa·’ă·nî hin·nêh nā·ṯat·tî ’it·tōw ’êṯ ’ā·ho·lî·’āḇ ben- ’ă·ḥî·sā·māḵ lə·maṭ·ṭêh- ḏān ū·ḇə·lêḇ kāl- ḥă·ḵam- lêḇ nā·ṯat·tî ḥāḵ·māh wə·‘ā·śū ’êṯ kāl- ’ă·šer ṣiw·wî·ṯi·ḵā
verses.literal: Moreover, I . . . have selected Oholiab son of Ahisamach of the tribe of Dan as his assistant I have also given skill to all the craftsmen . . . . . . that they may fashion all that I have commanded you
verses.literalPt: E eis que eu tenho posto com ele a Aoliabe, o filho de Aisamaque, da tribo de Dã, e tenho dado sabedoria ao coração de todos aqueles que são hábeis, para que façam tudo o que te tenho ordenado.

verses.original: אֵ֣ת׀ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֗ד וְאֶת־ הָֽאָרֹן֙ לָֽעֵדֻ֔ת וְאֶת־ הַכַּפֹּ֖רֶת אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָלָ֑יו וְאֵ֖ת כָּל־ כְּלֵ֥י הָאֹֽהֶל׃
verses.transliteration: ’êṯ ’ō·hel mō·w·‘êḏ wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·rōn lā·‘ê·ḏuṯ wə·’eṯ- hak·kap·pō·reṯ ’ă·šer ‘ā·lāw wə·’êṯ kāl- kə·lê hā·’ō·hel
verses.literal: the Tent of Meeting the ark of the Testimony and the mercy seat upon it and all the other furnishings of the tent
verses.literalPt: A saber: a tenda da congregação, e a arca do testemunho, e o propiciatório que estará sobre ela, e todos os pertences da tenda;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְאֶת־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָ֥ה הַטְּהֹרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- haš·šul·ḥān wə·’eṯ- kê·lāw wə·’eṯ- ham·mə·nō·rāh haṭ·ṭə·hō·rāh wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·le·hā wə·’êṯ miz·baḥ haq·qə·ṭō·reṯ
verses.literal: the table with its utensils the pure gold lampstand with all its utensils the altar of incense
verses.literalPt: E a mesa com os seus utensílios, e o candelabro de ouro puro com todos os seus pertences, e o altar do incenso;

verses.original: וְאֶת־ מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֶת־ הַכִּיּ֖וֹר וְאֶת־ כַּנּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- miz·baḥ hā·‘ō·lāh wə·’eṯ- kāl- kê·lāw wə·’eṯ- hak·kî·yō·wr wə·’eṯ- kan·nōw
verses.literal: the altar of burnt offering with all its utensils and the basin with its stand
verses.literalPt: E o altar do holocausto com todos os seus utensílios, e a pia com a sua base;

verses.original: וְאֵ֖ת בִּגְדֵ֣י הַשְּׂרָ֑ד וְאֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֤י הַקֹּ֙דֶשׁ֙ לְאַהֲרֹ֣ן הַכֹּהֵ֔ן וְאֶת־ בִּגְדֵ֥י בָנָ֖יו לְכַהֵֽן׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ biḡ·ḏê haś·śə·rāḏ wə·’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê haq·qō·ḏeš lə·’a·hă·rōn hak·kō·hên wə·’eṯ- biḡ·ḏê ḇā·nāw lə·ḵa·hên
verses.literal: as well as the woven garments both the holy garments for Aaron the priest and the garments for his sons to serve as priests
verses.literalPt: E as vestes do ministério, e as vestes sagradas de Arão o sacerdote, e as vestes de seus filhos, para administrarem o sacerdócio;

verses.original: וְאֵ֨ת שֶׁ֧מֶן הַמִּשְׁחָ֛ה וְאֶת־ קְטֹ֥רֶת הַסַּמִּ֖ים לַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ כְּכֹ֥ל אֲשֶׁר־ צִוִּיתִ֖ךָ יַעֲשֽׂוּ׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’êṯ še·men ham·miš·ḥāh wə·’eṯ- qə·ṭō·reṯ has·sam·mîm laq·qō·ḏeš kə·ḵōl ’ă·šer- ṣiw·wî·ṯi·ḵā ya·‘ă·śū
verses.literal: in addition to the anointing oil and fragrant incense for the Holy Place They are to make them according to all that I have commanded you
verses.literalPt: E o azeite da unção, e o incenso aromático para o santuário; farão conforme a tudo que te tenho mandado.

verses.literal: And the LORD said to Moses . . .
verses.literalPt: Falou mais o SENHOR a Moisés, dizendo:

verses.original: וְאַתָּ֞ה דַּבֵּ֨ר אֶל־ בְּנֵ֤י יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר אַ֥ךְ אֶת־ שַׁבְּתֹתַ֖י תִּשְׁמֹ֑רוּ כִּי֩ א֨וֹת הִ֜וא בֵּינִ֤י וּבֵֽינֵיכֶם֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם לָדַ֕עַת כִּ֛י אֲנִ֥י יְהוָ֖ה מְקַדִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’at·tāh dab·bêr ’el- bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl lê·mōr ’aḵ ’eṯ- šab·bə·ṯō·ṯay tiš·mō·rū kî ’ō·wṯ hî bê·nî ū·ḇê·nê·ḵem lə·ḏō·rō·ṯê·ḵem lā·ḏa·‘aṯ kî ’ă·nî Yah·weh mə·qad·diš·ḵem
verses.literal: Tell . . . the Israelites . . . . . . Surely you must keep My Sabbaths for this will be a sign between Me and you for the generations to come so that you may know that I am the LORD who sanctifies you
verses.literalPt: Tu, pois, fala aos filhos de Israel, dizendo: Certamente guardareis meus sábados; porquanto isso é um sinal entre mim e vós nas vossas gerações; para que saibais que eu sou o SENHOR, que vos santifica.

verses.original: וּשְׁמַרְתֶּם֙ אֶת־ הַשַּׁבָּ֔ת כִּ֛י קֹ֥דֶשׁ הִ֖וא לָכֶ֑ם מְחַֽלְלֶ֙יהָ֙ מ֣וֹת יוּמָ֔ת כִּ֗י כָּל־ הָעֹשֶׂ֥ה בָהּ֙ מְלָאכָ֔ה וְנִכְרְתָ֛ה הַנֶּ֥פֶשׁ הַהִ֖וא מִקֶּ֥רֶב עַמֶּֽיהָ׃
verses.transliteration: ū·šə·mar·tem ’eṯ- haš·šab·bāṯ kî qō·ḏeš hî lā·ḵem mə·ḥal·le·hā mō·wṯ yū·māṯ kî kāl- hā·‘ō·śeh ḇāh mə·lā·ḵāh wə·niḵ·rə·ṯāh han·ne·p̄eš ha·hi·w miq·qe·reḇ ‘am·me·hā
verses.literal: Keep the Sabbath for it is holy to you Anyone who profanes it must surely be put to death . . . Whoever does any work on that day - must be cut off from among his people
verses.literalPt: Portanto guardareis o sábado, porque santo é para vós; aquele que o profanar certamente morrerá; porque qualquer que nele fizer alguma obra, aquela alma será eliminada do meio do seu povo.

verses.original: שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִים֮ יֵעָשֶׂ֣ה מְלָאכָה֒ וּבַיּ֣וֹם הַשְּׁבִיעִ֗י שַׁבַּ֧ת שַׁבָּת֛וֹן קֹ֖דֶשׁ לַיהוָ֑ה כָּל־ הָעֹשֶׂ֧ה מְלָאכָ֛ה בְּי֥וֹם הַשַּׁבָּ֖ת מ֥וֹת יוּמָֽת׃
verses.transliteration: šê·šeṯ yā·mîm yê·‘ā·śeh mə·lā·ḵāh ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î šab·baṯ šab·bā·ṯō·wn qō·ḏeš Yah·weh kāl- hā·‘ō·śeh mə·lā·ḵāh bə·yō·wm haš·šab·bāṯ mō·wṯ yū·māṯ
verses.literal: For six days work may be done but the seventh day is a Sabbath of complete rest holy to the LORD Whoever does any work on the Sabbath day must surely be put to death . . .
verses.literalPt: Seis dias se trabalhará, porém o sétimo dia é o sábado do descanso, santo ao SENHOR; qualquer que no dia do sábado fizer algum trabalho, certamente morrerá.

verses.original: וְשָׁמְר֥וּ בְנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל אֶת־ הַשַּׁבָּ֑ת לַעֲשׂ֧וֹת אֶת־ הַשַּׁבָּ֛ת לְדֹרֹתָ֖ם בְּרִ֥ית עוֹלָֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·šā·mə·rū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- haš·šab·bāṯ la·‘ă·śō·wṯ ’eṯ- haš·šab·bāṯ lə·ḏō·rō·ṯām bə·rîṯ ‘ō·w·lām
verses.literal: The Israelites . . . must keep the Sabbath celebrating it as a permanent covenant for the generations to come
verses.literalPt: Guardarão, pois, o sábado os filhos de Israel, celebrando-o nas suas gerações por aliança perpétua.

verses.original: בֵּינִ֗י וּבֵין֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל א֥וֹת הִ֖וא לְעֹלָ֑ם כִּי־ שֵׁ֣שֶׁת יָמִ֗ים עָשָׂ֤ה יְהוָה֙ אֶת־ הַשָּׁמַ֣יִם וְאֶת־ הָאָ֔רֶץ וּבַיּוֹם֙ הַשְּׁבִיעִ֔י שָׁבַ֖ת וַיִּנָּפַֽשׁ׃ס
verses.transliteration: bê·nî ū·ḇên bə·nê yiś·rā·’êl ’ō·wṯ hî lə·‘ō·lām kî- šê·šeṯ yā·mîm ‘ā·śāh Yah·weh ’eṯ- haš·šā·ma·yim wə·’eṯ- hā·’ā·reṣ ū·ḇay·yō·wm haš·šə·ḇî·‘î šā·ḇaṯ way·yin·nā·p̄aš
verses.literal: It is a sign between Me . . . and the Israelites . . . forever for in six days the LORD made the heavens and the earth but on the seventh day He rested and was refreshed
verses.literalPt: Entre mim e os filhos de Israel será um sinal para sempre; porque em seis dias fez o SENHOR os céus e a terra, e ao sétimo dia descansou, e restaurou-se.

verses.original: וַיִּתֵּ֣ן אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֗ה כְּכַלֹּתוֹ֙ לְדַבֵּ֤ר אִתּוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר סִינַ֔י שְׁנֵ֖י לֻחֹ֣ת הָעֵדֻ֑ת לֻחֹ֣ת אֶ֔בֶן כְּתֻבִ֖ים בְּאֶצְבַּ֥ע אֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yit·tên ’el- mō·šeh kə·ḵal·lō·ṯōw lə·ḏab·bêr ’it·tōw bə·har sî·nay šə·nê lu·ḥōṯ hā·‘ê·ḏuṯ lu·ḥōṯ ’e·ḇen kə·ṯu·ḇîm bə·’eṣ·ba‘ ’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: When the LORD had finished speaking with Moses on Mount Sinai He gave . . . him the two tablets of the Testimony tablets of stone inscribed by the finger of God
verses.literalPt: E deu a Moisés (quando acabou de falar com ele no monte Sinai) as duas tábuas do testemunho, tábuas de pedra, escritas pelo dedo de Deus.
